note: Step 1 of the desk simplification (J 2026-11-24). One price check for every sport. trust = share of our projection's gap from the market that the price check keeps, applied in log-odds: trusted = logit(fair) + trust x (logit(ours) - logit(fair)). Seeds come from the research each sport already used (points-share b and blend weights; near 50% a points share and a log-odds share are about equal). Step 2 refits these weekly from live grades.
